mapper.select: SELECT s.doc::text AS doc, s.version, s.updated_at, u.display_name AS updated_by_display_name FROM event_roster_sheets s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.updated_by WHERE s.space_id = #{spaceId} AND s.event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_roster_sheets (event_id, space_id, doc, version, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{spaceId}, CAST(#{doc} AS jsonb), 1, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
